sources.title: Voktty workflow, installation and source lineage
sources.locator: Agents; Phone companion; Set up agents; Platform signing; Origin and attribution
sources.finding: Documents Tauri2/Rust/React19, local/SSH coding tools, API models, preview Android companion, no-account/no-telemetry claim and unsigned OS preview builds. It explicitly identifies an independent Terax hard fork and MonoCode-derived harness adapters.

sources.title: Client actions and privacy statements
sources.locator: Agent Harness; Files/Git; Privacy and security
sources.finding: Documents independent CLI sessions, native SSH helper, session review, source-control stage/commit/push, team coordination, preview Android and provider keys. Terminal launch presets are distinct from structured harness adapters.

sources.title: Registered harness adapters
sources.finding: Registers specific coding-agent adapters separately from the generic API-model agent loop.

sources.title: Actual Claude Code process launch
sources.finding: Builds native Claude session/resume arguments and spawns the selected executable in the session directory with provider-account metadata.

sources.title: Actual Codex App Server process launch
sources.finding: Spawns the selected Codex executable with app-server, directory and provider-account metadata.

sources.title: Agent teams, adapters and control protocol
sources.locator: Supported Provider Adapters; Supervised/Automatic; CLI Control Plane; Remote SSH
sources.finding: Names coding-harness adapter identities and a product team roster, role/rule files, authenticated control bridge, start/message/wait/result CLI and Git worktree copies. Human-supervised tasks wait for owner dispatch.

sources.title: Product-owned team launch and worktree authority
sources.locator: resolveAgentSupervised; worktree checks; session creation; lines807-953
sources.finding: The product enforces supervised defaults, obtains an authorized local agent-copy worktree, creates a session, seeds supervised tasks or sends an automatic turn, and delivers pending messages. Remote SSH agent copies with worktrees are explicitly rejected.

sources.title: Product-owned agent control bridge
sources.finding: Authenticated project/team requests route to the product launcher and message bus rather than merely displaying provider-native subagents.

sources.title: Actual session snapshot diff interface
sources.finding: Loads original/current session checkpoint contents, builds a unified file model and renders UnifiedDiffView. Binary/oversized/no-text states are explicit.

sources.title: Vendor actual diff-review original
sources.finding: The original pixels show an index.php patch with added/removed lines and Deshacer, Conservar and Revisar controls. The source already blurs some prompt/file content; no researcher pixel edits were made. An exact color-token change is not established by this image.

sources.title: Persistent automation schedule model
sources.finding: Defines hourly/daily/weekdays/weekly schedules, prompt/provider/workspace state and due-run claims. Event-kind types alone do not establish working webhook ingestion.

sources.title: Automatic due-run dispatch
sources.finding: While the desktop hook is mounted, a15-second poll claims due runs, creates/adopts a harness session and submits the configured prompt. This does not establish scheduling with the application closed.

sources.title: Client package metadata
sources.finding: The pinned package is Voktty frontend metadata; source head features are not assigned automatically to older release assets.

sources.title: Tauri desktop implementation
sources.finding: The client uses a Rust/Tauri core, consistent with the documented React frontend.

sources.title: Voktty application license
sources.finding: The named Voktty application is Apache-2.0; the README separately attributes upstream Terax ancestry and MIT MonoCode-derived adapters.
